items.en: Russia's top tank maker takes on T-90 repairs as new builds strain
items.nl: Grootste Russische tankfabrikant neemt T-90-reparaties op zich terwijl nieuwbouw onder druk staat
items.sEn: According to Defence Blog, Uralvagonzavod (UVZ) in Nizhny Tagil, Russia's main tank manufacturer and the only plant building new T-90M tanks, is now carrying out major (capital) repairs of T-90Ms badly damaged in Ukraine. items.en: Russia's New T-90M and T-72B3M Tanks Arrive With Upgraded Anti-Drone Protection
items.nl: Nieuwe Russische T-90M- en T-72B3M-tanks krijgen verbeterde anti-drone-bescherming
